notes: Owner: WP5 (BaseLayout reads it, perimeter.gd reads the kits and the projects). A kit is what a slot of the base's perimeter is built with. Its catalogue entry in the layout's `buildings` has the id "kit_<kit>" (a fence slot's entries are "kit_<kit>@<slot id>": see per_tiles) and `slot_kit` = the kit id; a slot's `kits` lists kit ids, its Build plot's `kits` lists the building ids. hp is the section's hit points (for door_plank, `bonus` true: hit points ADDED to the barred door). scrap and work (builder-hours) are the cost. effects are the building effects the colony reads through build.bonus/factor (tower: reach_bonus, reach_radius; floodlight: night_reach_mult). `stand` is how far outside the fence's outer face the dead stand to claw it. `per_tiles` (fence kits): the numbers are for a section of that many tiles, and a longer or shorter section has its scrap, work and hit points in proportion, so a ring costs and holds the same however it is cut up (layout.per_tiles). Tuned by the One House balance pass with tools/house_lab.gd (these are the numbers the perimeter reads; the `kits` block of one_house_tuning.json is not read): a plain fence 200 for 5 tiles, a reinforced one 360, the gate 260, and planks add 110 to a barred door's 90, so that a door holds as long as a fence. UNLOCK (EARLY, the dead come after two rescues): a slot opens by how many people there are (the avatar counted); the first attack comes with three, so everything a good first fortification needs is open by three (1: the front fence and the door planks; 2: the gate and a tower; 3: the sides, the back, the second tower, the floodlights, reinforcing). PROJECTS: what the player orders, with one click each (the Build page, scripts/ui/slot_page.gd): a project is the slots of its `roles` (the unlock table's keys, base_layout.gd gives each slot one), built with its `kit`, and the page lists them in this order, which is also the recommended order (the first that is ready is 'Next'). `crew`: a project with `upgrade` true (it makes the built plain fences into the `kit`) has no slot stage of its own and opens with this many people. `gives` is the one line on its card, `noun` how the objective and the card name it, `done` what the toast says when the last section of it is up.

fence.name: Fence section
fence.blurb: Cheap and weak: planks, wire and posts. The dead tear it down in a few minutes.

fence_strong.name: Reinforced fence
fence_strong.blurb: Doubled planks and sheet metal. Close to twice the hit points of a plain section.

gate.name: Gate
gate.blurb: A gate on the front. People pass whole; shut, it is a wall, and left open it lets the dead in.

door_plank.name: Planked door
door_plank.blurb: Planks across the barred door: it holds much longer.

tower.name: Small tower
tower.blurb: A lookout and a firing platform: shooters near it reach three tiles further.

floodlight.name: Floodlight
floodlight.blurb: A lamp on a pole and a generator: the guns reach a little further by night and a blackout costs no aim.

projects.name: Front fence
projects.gives: Walls off the street side. The dead have to tear it down, or go round.

projects.name: The gate
projects.gives: A way in for people, in front of the door. Shut, it holds like a fence. Open, it lets the dead in.

projects.name: Watchtower
projects.gives: A lookout and a firing platform: the guns near it reach three tiles further.

projects.name: Side fences
projects.gives: Closes both flanks, so the dead cannot just walk round the front.

projects.name: Back fence
projects.gives: Shuts the last side. With it the ring is closed.

projects.name: Floodlights
projects.gives: Lamps on poles with their own generator: the guns reach a little further by night, and a blackout costs no aim.

projects.name: Door planks
projects.gives: Planks across both doors of the house. The last line holds much longer.

projects.name: Second watchtower
projects.gives: Covers the other corner of the yard. Towers do not add up: each one reaches the guns that stand near it.

projects.name: Reinforce the fences
projects.gives: Sheet metal and doubled planks on every fence you have built, one section at a time. Close to twice the hit points. The fence stands while it is done.
